# 04 — Cost Relations & Aggregation

This doc covers how the three cost categories (TC, MC, DC) **relate to each other**, how they flow into **P&L reports**, what the **Dashboard Cost Overview** aggregates, and the **module usage matrix**.

---

## 1. Trip Cost → Driver Cost Auto-Sync

When a trip cost in group **TC-G-004 (Driver Expenses)** is saved, the system automatically creates a corresponding **driver cost** in group **DC-G-004 (Other)**. This is a **one-way sync**: Trip → Driver. The driver cost entry includes a `trip_id` for traceability.

### Sync Flow

```
User saves Trip Cost (TC-G-004)
  ↓
TripCostToDriverCostMapper.isDriverExpense(entry) → true
  ↓
TripCostToDriverCostMapper.mapToDriverCost(entry, driverId, tripId, date)
  ↓
CreateDriverCostRequest created with:
  - costId    = mapped DC-xxx-xxx
  - groupId   = "DC-G-004"
  - tripId    = original trip's ID
  - month     = extracted from date (YYYY-MM)
  - isDeduction = false
  ↓
ViewModel calls createDriverCost API
```

### Mapping Table

| Trip Cost ID | Trip Cost Label | → Driver Cost ID | Driver Cost Label |
|-------------|-----------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| `TC-004-001` | Driver Allowance | `DC-004-001` | Driver Allowance (Trip) |
| `TC-004-002` | Food & Meals | `DC-004-002` | Driver Food (Trip) |
| `TC-004-003` | Accommodation | `DC-004-002` | Driver Accommodation (Trip) |

> Both TC-004-002 (Food) and TC-004-003 (Accommodation) map to the same DC-004-002 (Travel Allowance equivalent).

### Detection Constants

```kotlin
const val TRIP_DRIVER_EXPENSE_GROUP_ID = "TC-G-004"
const val DRIVER_OTHER_ALLOWANCE_GROUP_ID = "DC-G-004"
```

### Detection Logic

```kotlin
fun isDriverExpense(entry: CostEntryRow): Boolean {
    return entry.selectedGroupId == TRIP_DRIVER_EXPENSE_GROUP_ID ||
           entry.costType.startsWith("TC-004")
}
```

### Source File

`screen-trip/.../presentation/cost/util/TripCostToDriverCostMapper.kt`

## 2. P&L Aggregation Formulas

P&L reports are generated by `screen-report` (Owner/GM only). The formulas determine what counts as revenue vs expense.

### Trip P&L

```
Trip P&L = selling_value − total_trip_costs

Where:
  selling_value  = trip_price (revenue from customer)
  total_trip_costs = Sum of all TC-* costs for the trip
```

**Included:** All TC-* costs (fuel, toll, loading, driver expenses, permits, misc).
**Excluded:** DC-* costs, MC-* costs, EMI payments.

> Note: The `cost_breakdown` field in `TripProfitLossDto` lists TC-* cost totals grouped by type.

### Vehicle P&L

```
Vehicle P&L = total_revenue − total_trip_costs − total_maintenance_costs

Where:
  total_revenue          = Sum of trip_price for all completed trips
  total_trip_costs       = Sum of all TC-* costs across all trips for the vehicle
  total_maintenance_costs = Sum of all MC-* costs for the vehicle
```

**Included:** TC-* costs + MC-* costs.
**Excluded:** DC-* costs, EMI payments.

> `VehicleProfitLossDto` provides separate `totalTripCosts` and `totalMaintenanceCosts` fields plus a unified `totalExpenses`.

### Cost Analysis

Drills into a **single cost type** across vehicles and time. Returns `CostTypeAnalysis` with:
- Total amount and count for the chosen type
- Vehicle breakdown (which vehicle spent how much)
- Monthly trend (spending over time)

### Consolidated P&L (Fleet-wide)

```
Fleet P&L = total_revenue − total_expenses

Where:
  total_revenue  = Sum of all trip revenue fleet-wide
  total_expenses = total_trip_costs + total_maintenance_costs (fleet-wide)
```

Provides `vehicleSummary`, `tripSummary`, `costBreakdown`, and `periodBreakdown` lists.

### What's NOT in P&L

| Category | Why Excluded |
|----------|-------------|
| **Driver Costs (DC-*)** | These are workforce costs, not trip/vehicle operational expenses. The TC-G-004 portion is already counted in Trip P&L as a trip cost — the DC-* sync is for the driver's personal cost history only. |
| **EMI / Loan Payments** | Capital expenditure, not operational. Tracked separately in `screen-finance`. |
| **Trip Payments** | Payments are on the **revenue side** — they track how much of the trip_price has been collected, not expenses. |

## 3. Dashboard Cost Overview

The Dashboard's **Cost Overview** section (`CostOverviewSection.kt`) aggregates cost data across filter periods (Today / Weekly / Monthly).

### CostOverview Entity Fields → Source

| Field | Source | Category |
|-------|--------|----------|
| `totalExpenses` | TC-* + MC-* totals for period | Combined |
| `totalRevenue` | Sum of trip_price for completed trips | Revenue |
| `profitLoss` | `totalRevenue − totalExpenses` | Computed |
| `tripCosts` | Sum of all TC-* costs | Trip Costs |
| `maintenanceCosts` | Sum of all MC-* costs | Maintenance |
| `fuelCosts` | Sum of TC-G-001 items | Trip Costs subset |
| `tollCosts` | Sum of TC-G-002 items | Trip Costs subset |
| `driverAllowanceExpenses` | Sum of TC-G-004 items | Trip Costs subset |
| `parkingExpenses` | TC-002-002 total | Trip Costs subset |
| `loadingCharges` | Sum of TC-G-003 items (loading) | Trip Costs subset |
| `unloadingCharges` | Sum of TC-G-003 items (unloading) | Trip Costs subset |
| `chalanExpenses` | TC-005-003 total | Trip Costs subset |
| `permitExpenses` | TC-005-001 + TC-005-002 total | Trip Costs subset |
| `insuranceExpenses` | Legacy `insurance` type total | Trip Costs subset |
| `tripCostBreakdown` | List of `CostBreakdownItem` for TC-* | Detailed |
| `maintenanceCostBreakdown` | List of `CostBreakdownItem` for MC-* | Detailed |

> Dashboard cost overview does NOT include DC-* (driver costs) or EMI payments.

## 4. Module Usage Matrix

Which module creates, reads, or aggregates each cost category:

| Module | TC-* (Trip) | MC-* (Maint.) | DC-* (Driver) | Payments | EMI/Finance |
|--------|:-----------:|:--------------:|:--------------:|:--------:|:-----------:|
| `ijs-core-lib` | DTOs + Fallback | DTOs + Fallback | DTOs + Fallback | — | — |
| `ijs-network-lib` | CRUD DataSource | CRUD DataSource | CRUD DataSource | — | — |
| `screen-trip` | **Create**/Read | — | Create (sync) | — | — |
| `screen-vehicle` | Read (costs tab) | **Create**/Read | — | — | — |
| `screen-driver` | — | — | **Create**/Read | — | — |
| `screen-payment` | — | — | — | **Create**/Read | — |
| `screen-finance` | — | — | — | — | **Create**/Read |
| `screen-report` | Aggregate (P&L) | Aggregate (P&L) | — | — | — |
| `screen-dashboard` | Read (overview) | Read (overview) | — | Read (pending) | — |
| `screen-alerts` | — | — | — | — | — |
| `ijs-ui-components-lib` | Display components | Display components | — | — | — |
| `ijs-pdf-report` | PDF export | PDF export | PDF export | PDF export | — |

**Legend:** **Bold** = primary entry point for creating costs.

| File | Module | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `TripCostToDriverCostMapper.kt` | `screen-trip` | TC→DC auto-sync mapper |
